title: EMS-Nav: Embodied Multi-Scale Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.15589v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial inspection robots must reach work areas and specific equipment. These destinations span spatial scales from regions to objects, so robots must relate each target to its surroundings to interpret the task and determine where to go. Existing methods support multi-scale navigation through rich environment representations, but at substantial computational and storage cost. These costs limit deployment where wireless coverage is incomplete and robots must rely on onboard computation to keep navigating. We introduce EMS-Nav, a biologically inspired multi-scale navigation framework for online, on-device operation. Its core innovation is to organize perception, spatial understanding, and navigation around regions, making local spaces the basic units of both environmental understanding and computation. translated_abstract: 工业巡检机器人必须到达工作区域和特定设备。这些目的地跨越从区域到物体的多个空间尺度，因此机器人必须将每个目标与其周围环境联系起来，以理解任务并确定前往的地点。现有方法通过丰富的环境表示来支持多尺度导航，但计算和存储成本高昂。这些成本限制了机器人在无线覆盖不完整、必须依赖机载计算来维持导航的场景中的部署。我们提出EMS-Nav，这是一个受生物学启发的多尺度导航框架，可实现在线的设备端操作。其核心创新在于围绕“区域”来组织感知、空间理解和导航，将局部空间作为环境理解和计算的基本单元。EMS-Nav将物体及其关系分组为具有功能意义的空间，并构建从局部区域到更大范围环境的层级结构。
tldr: EMS-Nav提出了一种受生物启发的多尺度导航框架，以功能性的局部空间区域为环境理解和计算的基本单元，从而在大幅降低计算与存储成本的前提下实现机载在线的多尺度导航。
en_tdlr: EMS-Nav is a biologically inspired multi-scale navigation framework that organizes perception, spatial understanding, and computation around functional local regions, enabling efficient online on-device navigation at significantly reduced cost.
